source.title: Opinion and Order on Sanctions, June 22, 2023

court_findings.does_not_exist: The court found the decision does not exist.
court_findings.does_not_exist_as_cited: The court found no decision at the cited reporter and court, though a different case has the same name.
court_findings.does_not_support: The decision exists but does not support what it was cited for.
court_findings.quote_not_in_opinion: The decision exists but does not contain the language quoted from it.
court_findings.supports: The decision supports what it was cited for.
court_findings.supports_in_part: The decision supports what it was cited for in part.
